subject: Security

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: Database access goes through Dapper's parameterized CommandDefinition with static, literal-only SQL scripts — no string concatenation of any input

evidence.excerpt: public const string SqlServerResetTestingScript = @"...DELETE FROM Categories WHERE categoryName = 'Test Cat'..."

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: The only request parameter in scope (About's show-details bool) is a simple, model-bound boolean with no injection surface.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: No shell/OS process execution code exists in the reviewed files.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: No XML parsing code exists in the reviewed files.

notes: The API's current attack surface for injection is minimal: only two GET endpoints with trivial inputs and one POST endpoint with no request body, and all SQL is static/parameterized. No findings raised, but this should be re-reviewed if endpoints accepting free-form input are added.
